text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, at Mr. C.B.'s
request, we stopped by a mall to shop—
and bumped right into Yukino Bijin in front of a store.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, CB-san!
Are you out shopping with your Trainer, gansu?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. To buy souvenirs for my parents.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!? Th-That's right!
I got a care package sent from home the other day too...!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is that so? In that case, want to pick out a return gift together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Are ya sure?
Then I'll leave it to ya!

text_block_list.name: All Staff
text_block_list.text: —Congratulaaaations!!!!

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Customer, you are the 1,000,000th visitor
to our mall!

text_block_list.name: Staff B
text_block_list.text: Please accept this commemorative gift~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Th-That sure looks like
a fancy table clock...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This might make a great souvenir for your parents.
If it were my parents, they'd probably flip out, though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really? Want me to give you some, then?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wah! Thank you ve――

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh!? W-Whaddya mean!?
I-I'm not worthy of such an honor, gansu...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back!
I wanna find something else on my own anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This hat is totally Dad's style, but...
Mom just gave him one for their anniversary, so...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Rusks, huh? Not a bad choice, but didn't Mom say she was on a diet—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How about this one? It's a C.B. mug, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm. My parents might've already bought it, though—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm, wait a sec. Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. With this matching pair of teacups,
I'm sure they'll love it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Dad's broke before, and he was saying we'd have to buy a new matching pair.
choice_data_list: That's a perfect souvenir for your parents.
That's a perfect souvenir for your parents.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. It's all thanks to the hint you gave me, Yukino.
Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! If anything, I feel like
the scales have fallen from my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My parents are always happy no matter what I give 'em. So I never hesitated and just picked whatever looked super city-slick and modern.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, CB-san thought it through and through
to pick out the best one...
I felt like I ought to follow her example!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't you think you're overthinking
things a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
They're gifts for the people I love, after all.
I might as well enjoy taking my time choosing them freely.
choice_data_list: That feels like it'd naturally put more heart into it.
That feels like it'd naturally put more heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In our house,
that turns into a quiz every single time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-A quiz?
What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? It's a quiz to guess
why I chose that present.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hae~... So every time you give each other a present,
you turn it into a quiz?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Whenever I tell my parents to guess,
they get it right a hundred percent of the time!"
choice_data_list: You two have a great parent-child bond.
You two have a wonderful parent-child relationship.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Whenever I tell my parents to guess,
they get it right a hundred percent of the time!"
choice_data_list: You two have a great parent-child bond.
You two have a wonderful parent-child relationship.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well now, ain't that somethin'...! 
Th-That's so stylish...! 
It's like somethin' straight outta drama~...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. You think so?
I'm not really sure.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, I kind of like that, though. Things like that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really? In that case, want to give it a try too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Once we both receive our presents, you know?
We try to guess the message tucked inside them."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course! In that case,
first we need to think of a present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, what should I choose?
Pondering that, I made my way home for the day.
